decision.reason: the aggregate lower-bound threshold is only 5.1825556081 percent annual for already-held collateral, but the fixed-role persistence gate requires at least 14.1066194737 percent and newly acquiring and redeeming BFUSD at the guide's typical friction raises the worst-role sensitivity to 25.6329352632 percent; no public current rate or account eligibility proves either threshold

limitations: The inherited 74-row BTC alignment is explicitly non-authoritative because its nearest-hour timestamp rule was not frozen before source access.
The source attempt did not complete ETH or SOL and therefore provides no multi-asset persistence evidence.
The documented six-percent Polymarket OI reward requires one-million-USD daily-average gross OI and authenticated realization evidence.
BFUSD daily reward rates vary with funding and ETH staking income and are not guaranteed to remain constant.
The typical 0.1-percent subscription and redemption fees are guide sensitivities, not exact account quota evidence.
Nearly 100-percent collateral value is not an exact account collateral ratio or proof of liquidation-safe capital efficiency.
pUSD-USDT basis, cross-venue execution, custody, redemption delay, liquidation, auto-deleveraging, tax, and operational costs remain unmeasured.
